name: Galen Strawson
notes: Q3 s: open to 'stuff monism' / only one ultimate; Q8 s: treats objects as processes but not Whiteheadian occasions.

name: Philip Goff
notes: Q1 s: earlier micropsychist, now priority cosmopsychist; Q12 s: consciousness is the intrinsic nature of the physical but outside what physical science (quantitative) captures.

name: David Chalmers
notes: Q4 y: accepts physics is structural and finds Russellian monism attractive without committing; Q9 s: Chalmers-McQueen collapse interactionism; Q12 n: naturalistic dualism.

name: Michael Tye
notes: Q11 y is his core thesis (no vague consciousness); Q2 s: unsure how he relates macro to micro consciousness; Q4 n: representationalist physicalist, not Russellian.

name: Sam Coleman
notes: Q2 n: mind combines subjectless qualities, not smaller experiences; Q12 y: Russellian monism as a form of physicalism.

name: Rupert Sheldrake
notes: Q6 y and Q7 y are his clearest commitments; Q3 s: speculates the sun and galaxies are conscious, not committed to one cosmic mind; Q9 s: morphic fields are causal, but not identified with consciousness.

name: Alfred North Whitehead
notes: Q5 n: eternal objects are unexperienced potentials, but qualities are only actual in occasions; Q7 y: only true organisms/societies with a dominant occasion, not aggregates.

name: Annaka Harris
notes: Open to consciousness being fundamental but uncommitted; Q5 s: argues experience needs no self, which is not quite subjectless qualities; Q6 s: no clear receiver endorsement; Q12 y: frames it as a question for fundamental physics.

name: Itay Shani
notes: Q6 y: with Keppler, brains resonate with/tap into a ubiquitous consciousness-bearing field (ZPF); Q12 y: that field is physical.
